phases.name: CI fan-out topology
phases.command: gh run list -R cogneiss/starter --workflow=tests.yml --branch main --limit 1 --json conclusion

phases.name: dead code and unused deps
phases.command: composer test:dead-code && composer test:deps && composer test:knip

phases.name: mutation testing
phases.note: Non-blocking by design (plan Phase 9). `composer test:mutate` exits non-zero at the current score of 79.32% on app/Actions; the threshold stays at --min=80 and is not lowered to make it pass.

phases.name: SBOM on release
phases.command: composer sbom && test -s sbom.json && rm sbom.json

phases.name: documentation
phases.command: grep -q "493 tests" FEATURES.md README.md && test -f CONTRIBUTING.md && test -f .ai/rules/ci.md

phases.name: full gate green
phases.command: composer test:lint && composer test:type-coverage && composer test:types && XDEBUG_MODE=coverage herd coverage vendor/bin/pest --parallel --coverage --exactly=100.0
phases.note: This is `composer test` expanded. The last step is spelled out because a local run needs Herd's `herd coverage` wrapper to load a coverage driver; CI installs pcov and runs `composer test` as-is.
